title: Warm Crispy German Ikura Bowl
description: A herbal and crispy German dish featuring ikura, served in a warm dolsot stone bowl, perfect for a cozy meal. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe combines smoky and cold elements for a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the dolsot stone bowl in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
Cook the German sausage slices in a pan over medium heat until browned and crispy.
Add the sliced onions to the pan and cook until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Mix the caraway seeds, rye bread crumbs, and smoked paprika in a bowl.
Add the cooked sausage and onions to the bowl and toss to combine with the seed and crumb mixture.
Spoon the ikura over the top of the sausage and onion mixture.
Garnish with chopped chives and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve the mixture in the preheated dolsot stone bowl.
Return the bowl to the oven for an additional 2 minutes to warm and crisp the ingredients.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for 1 minute before serving.
